html:
Unique Research · Company / Funding · August 4, 2022

On Jul 25, 2022, FMCG offline-retail intelligence platform Mashangying (马上赢) (founded 2016) closed a multi-million RMB Series B from Lushang Fund (Shandong Commercial Group) — 5th round total. Free BI/intel for retailers → POS data alliance (60k+ supermarket partners across Yangtze Delta, Pearl Delta, North China, Sichuan-Chongqing); paid CT reports for brands (Yuanqi Forest, Nanfu, Shuanghui, Li Ziqi…). Product graph: 18M+ SKUs / 267k manufacturers / 430k brands. Commercialized since Jun’21: rev at multi-million RMB scale; upsell 100%, repurchase ~90%.

— END —
